metadata.description: Call Center Analysis: storage, Event Grid, Functions (Flex Consumption), Azure AI Speech/Language/OpenAI, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, App Service web app, Key Vault and monitoring. All service-to-service access uses managed identities.
Short lowercase alphanumeric prefix for all resource names (3-8 chars).
Environment name, used in resource names and tags.
Region for all resources (except Azure OpenAI, see openAiLocation). Central India for the TSD baseline.
Extra tags applied to every resource.
Storage redundancy.
Move recordings to the Cool tier after N days.
Delete recordings after N days (must be greater than recordingCoolAfterDays).
Delete raw (un-redacted) transcripts after N days. Redacted insights are kept.
Azure AI Speech pricing tier.
Azure AI Language pricing tier.
Region for Azure OpenAI. Must offer the chosen model and deployment type.
Chat model used for call insights.
Model version.
Deployment type. Standard keeps processing in-region; GlobalStandard has the widest availability.
Deployment capacity in thousands of tokens per minute.
Cosmos DB capacity mode.
Provisioned RU/s for the calls container (Provisioned mode only).
Use the Cosmos DB free tier (one per subscription; Provisioned mode only).
App Service plan SKU for the web app.
Number of web app instances.
Functions hosting plan. FC1 = Flex Consumption (serverless).
Maximum Function instances (scale-out limit, also caps AI service concurrency).
Memory per Function instance.
Deploy Event Hubs to publish 'call insights ready' events (CRM feed, real-time phase).
Event Hubs tier.
Event Hubs throughput units.
Log Analytics retention in days.
Daily ingestion cap in GB (-1 = no cap).
Key Vault SKU.
Entra ID tenant for user sign-in.
Application (client) ID of the web app registration. Leave empty and run Deployment/scripts/setup_entra.sh after deployment.
Client secret of the app registration (stored in Key Vault). Leave empty if setup_entra.sh will create it.
Role for signed-in users without an app role assignment. Empty = deny.
API key for the CRM read API (header X-API-Key). Stored in Key Vault.
Django secret key. Generated if not provided.
Time zone used to display dates in the web app.
Power BI workspace ID for the embedded report (optional).
Power BI report ID for the embedded report (optional).
Object ID of the user/service principal running the deployment. Gets data access to Storage and Key Vault for seeding and setup scripts (optional).
Type of deployerPrincipalId.
